g.text: Two release paths turn the conferenceinto practical decisions
Start with grounded definitions, data navigationand question-scoped semantic context.
Then add explicit conversation state and boundedinvestigation for complex questions.
Pilot one rep-reviewed meeting-preparationjourney in the Salesforce workflow.
Close count and forecast correctness boundaries;bind narrative numbers to saved evidence.
Preserve metric identity and grain throughtransformation, refresh and report generation.
Use numerical outcome oracles, then completeone workspace-to-checked-result journey.
The same release test applies to both tracks:
accepted work + total human effort + full known cost + consequential failure modes.
Recommendations based on the application roadmap; proposed local designs, not demonstrated gains.
